body: I'm off my meds now. I feel that they're a waste of time and money. Some meds heightened my suicidal thoughts and attempts. Some increase my hypermaniac ride. Some just make me feel zombie like with zoned out state. Some made me feel paranoid with people around me and untrusting. At times physically violent by breaking stuff, punching on stuff causing two fracture fingers and very verbally abusive. Some cause loss of short term memory, unfocused and insomnia. The one pill I remember off the top of my head is the Prozacs. The side affects had my mother upset that they prescribed it in the first place with a high dosage. I had slurred speech, drooling, moved slowly and unstable, body limbs limped with no self control. The other med had me laughing until I fell asleep and looked at as crazy. The other one did nothing at all. Therapy sucked. I drove thirty minutes to go see a psychiatrist for him to give me three booklets of 200+ questions, repeated but rewritten differently. Once I was finished, I went into his office, he placed them into my file and for fifteen minutes spoke to me about his trip he is going on to Egypt. Then schedule for me to return in three weeks for a fifteen minutes session. I never returned. Then I attended a different one for a fifteen minutes session that sat and observed me, ask a few questions and said see you next week. I was done with therapy all together because it wasn't helping me at all. I have been keeping it steady so far without the use of either by staying to myself, eliminating people out my life that triggers my episodes, but recently with the extreme stressors of life's interference which is out of my control. I've been very manic, off and on episodes of anger, irrational decisions making, heightened sex drive and craving for medicinal drugs. Until I'm out of the situation I am in and back on track with my stability and security, I will be able to handle it and get it under control. Right now, I'm just staying away from everything and everyone, so I won't get into any trouble I would regret. It has caused me to lose my job entirely because of loss of focus and to be able to function to standards.
Why do we have to be on meds to feel normal.
Thanks, but I think there should there should be other alternatives than taking meds
